about_short_description.short_description: A1Smart Cam is a software company that is also a systems integrator and technology supplier.

product.name: Face Recognition
product.description: Automatically recognizes faces for law enforcement, crime detection, monitoring suspects, and verifying identities during transactions or sensitive processes.

product.name: A1 SMART CAM Dashboard
product.description: Counts the number of visitors, tracks the time, date, and duration of their visit, and monitors mask compliance.

product.name: Age and Gender Detection
product.description: Detects the gender and age of a person from a single image of a face using deep learning.

product.name: Heat Map
product.description: Creates a map of high-traffic areas, customer flow patterns, and areas of interest within a store.

product.name: Fire & Smoke Detection
product.description: Identifies smoke and fire in real time and sends alerts when a flame is detected or smoke exceeds a threshold.

product.name: Vehicle Count
product.description: Counts cars to monitor traffic, prevent accidents, and maintain transportation systems.
